c74object.name: zerr.combinator~
c74object.digest: Combine several envelope sets into one: sum, geometric mean or maximum per channel
c74object.description: Use the zerr.combinator~ object to merge the multi-channel envelope sets of several zerr.envelopes~ objects into one set, channel by channel: the sum, the geometric mean or the maximum of the inputs. The first argument is the number of sets, one multi-channel inlet each; the second is the mode. Every inlet must carry the same channel count, and the output has that many channels. The result feeds zerr.disperser~.

inlet.description: One multi-channel inlet per envelope set (the number of inlets is the first argument). All sets must have the same channel count, otherwise the object reports an error and outputs silence. Messages go to the left inlet.

outlet.description: A multi-channel signal with the same channel count as the inputs, one combined envelope per loudspeaker.

objarg.name: sets
objarg.description: How many multi-channel inlets the object has, at least 1. Default: 2.

objarg.name: mode
objarg.description: The initial combination mode, see the mode attribute. Default: max.

method.name: mode
method.description: Sets the mode attribute. Safe while audio runs.

method.name: bang
method.description: Posts the number of sets, the mode and the channel count to the Max Console.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: How the sets are merged in each channel.

enum.name: root
enum.description: The N-th root of the product of the N sets, a square root for two sets: a speaker sounds only where every set gives it some level.

enum.name: max
enum.description: The largest envelope in each channel (default).

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: The channel count of the current inputs and therefore of the output. 0 until signal connections exist.

c74object.discussion: Combining lets several features shape one distribution: for example one zerr.envelopes~ driven by loudness and another by brightness. Think of root as "and" and max as "or": root plays a speaker only where every feature wants it, which keeps the distribution focused, while max lets any feature claim a speaker, which keeps it wide. add is the sum, so it can exceed 1, and zerr.disperser~ does not limit; scale it down, for instance with the gain inlet of each zerr.envelopes~ or an mc.*~ after the combinator. The mode can be changed from the inspector, with the mode message or with the mode attribute, in all cases while audio runs and without a click. The number of sets is fixed at creation. If the inlets carry different channel counts the object reports an error and outputs silence until they match.
